api_rate_limited: Too many attempts, try again in a minute.
claim_consequence: Until you have answered, you see all of this household and can change nothing in it.
claim_create: None of them, create my person
claim_question: Who are you in this household?
emails_intro: Every verified address of yours can log you in. The primary one is the official address of the account: it is the one shown in the header. A new address stays unusable until its verification link has been followed.
household_delete_explains: The household goes with its people, its catalog and its trips. There is no undo.
household_leave_explains: The person you are here stays in the household, without your account: the others carry on with them.
household_new_intro: A household gathers the people you pack for.
invitation_account: You are about to join this household with the account {email}.
invitation_dead: This invitation is unknown, expired, or has already been accepted. A link is valid a week and works once. Ask an owner of the household to send you a new invitation.
invitation_from_unknown: You have been invited to join {household}.
invitation_sent: If this address can be invited, it will receive a link. The household does not say who already has an account: the invitation appears below if it was created.
invitations_intro: A link worth a week, sent to an address. Whoever accepts it then picks the person they already are here, or creates one.
me_name_intro: The name other members see is the one of the person who represents you in each household, not a field of the account: it is changed
member_remove: Remove their account from the household
member_remove_explains: {name} stays in the household without their account, with their name and their things. Remove the person next if they have nothing left to do here.
password_intro: The current password is asked for: a stolen session must not be enough to change it.
person_remove_order: Their account is still a member of the household: remove the account first, the person goes next.
person_remove_trips: The trip lines that were meant for them are not erased: they become common to the trip.
reset_key_dead: This link has expired or has already been used.
reset_sent: If an account uses this address, a link has just been sent to it.
signup_pending: Account created. A verification email has just gone out: follow its link to activate your account.
status_delete_explains: The trip lines carrying this status move to another status of the same section, or to the default status of the household. None is erased.
statuses_intro: The three sections are fixed: they drive the progress bar of a trip. Inside them, add and rename as many statuses as you need.
statuses_manage: Add, rename and colour the statuses
verify_confirm: Confirm that {email} is indeed your address.
verify_dead_after: if your account is already active.
verify_dead_before: This link has expired or has already been used. Start a new
verify_done_signed_in: Address confirmed, you are now logged in.
